//: Merge the relevant blocks into your own ~/.claude/settings.json or project .claude/settings.json. Do not overwrite your existing file wholesale.

permissions.//allow: Common safe, read-only commands — pre-approving these removes a permission round-trip per call. Trim to what you actually use.

hooks.//: Example: run formatting/lint automatically instead of asking the agent to check it every time. Replace the command with your project's real formatter.
